featuresTraits:
Build Direction: Ranged Battle Master
- Level 3 guest PC built around staying at range and making weapon attacks with Dexterity.
- Years alone in the forest made him especially comfortable with a crossbow.

Ability Score Assignment
- Rolled 16, 18, 10, 11, 7, 11.
- Assigned pre-racial: Str 11, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 11, Wis 10, Cha 7.
- Forest Gnome adds +2 Int and +1 Dex, for Dex 19 and Int 13.

Fighter Proficiencies
- Saving Throws: Strength and Constitution.
- Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics and Perception.

Fighting Style: Archery
- +2 bonus to attack rolls made with ranged weapons.

[Quick] Second Wind (1 use)
- Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + fighter level HP.
- Refreshes on a short or long rest.

[Quick] Action Surge (1 use)
- On your turn, take one additional action.
- Refreshes on a short or long rest.

Battle Master: Combat Superiority
- Superiority Dice: 4d8 per short or long rest.
- Maneuver Save DC: 14.

Maneuvers
- Precision Attack: Add a superiority die to an attack roll. Strong ranged option when a hit really matters.
- Menacing Attack: Add a superiority die to damage and force a Wisdom save or frighten the target.
- Pushing Attack: Add a superiority die to damage and force a Strength save or push the target up to 15 ft away.

Forest Gnome Traits
- Small size.
- Speed 25 ft.
- Darkvision 60 ft.
- Gnome Cunning: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.
- Natural Illusionist: Minor Illusion cantrip, using Intelligence as spellcasting ability.
- Speak with Small Beasts: Communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

Rules Notes
- Shortbow and hand crossbow avoid the Small-size disadvantage problem from heavy weapons.
- HP uses fixed average after level 1: 10 + Con at level 1, then 6 + Con for levels 2 and 3.

backstory:
Duldrick's charisma, or rizz, was so low that after repeated rejection he gave up on trying to make it work around other people and retreated into Rootspire Hollow. He lived alone in that forest for many years, getting by on caution, patience, and a steady hand with a crossbow.

For a long time, solitude suited him. Then Rootspire Hollow started getting weird in ways even Duldrick could not ignore. Strange signs, wrong sounds, and bad patterns pushed him back out of hiding and onto the road.
notes: Guest PC. Stats use the rolled array 16, 18, 10, 11, 7, 11 with Forest Gnome bonuses applied.
